key_catalyst: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire and Strait of Hormuz reopening trigger massive risk-on rotation
reasoning: A major geopolitical de-escalation involving the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and an Israel-Lebanon ceasefire has triggered a powerful risk-on rotation, directly reversing the prior week's oil-driven inflation fears. Combined with record ETF inflows and positive positioning ahead of Alphabet's earnings, the market is aggressively pricing in the positive catalyst. This strong pre-market absorption of resolving geopolitical threats leaves no bearish conviction to justify a sell.
